title: Systems Escalation Shift Lead
description:
**About ECI**
**ECI** 
 is the leading global provider of managed services, cybersecurity, and business transformation for mid\-market financial services organizations across the globe. From its unmatched range of services, ECI provides stability, security and improved business performance, freeing clients from technology concerns and enabling them to focus on running their businesses. More than 1,000 customers worldwide with over $3 trillion of assets under management put their trust in ECI.
   

  

 At ECI, we believe success is driven by passion and purpose. Our passion for technology is only surpassed by
 **our commitment to empowering our employees around the world** 
 .
   

  

****Role Overview****
 We are seeking a Senior Systems Engineer with deep expertise in Microsoft technologies, Azure cloud services, and enterprise migrations. This role involves designing, implementing, and managing complex infrastructure environments across Azure, Microsoft 365, Exchange, Intune, SharePoint, Teams, VMware, Citrix, and related technologies. The ideal candidate will lead migration and upgrade projects, ensure security compliance, and deliver scalable solutions aligned with ECI’s standards.
   

  

****Key Responsibilities****
- Azure Cloud Management

* Provision and manage Azure VMs, networking, and storage.
* Configure Azure AD, RBAC, App Registrations, and Key Vault.
* Implement ARM templates and Bicep for Infrastructure as Code.
* Monitor and troubleshoot using Azure Monitor and Log Analytics.
* Ensure security via Azure Security Center and compliance best practices.


- Microsoft 365 \& Exchange

* Administer Exchange Online and on\-prem Exchange (DAG, server roles).
* Configure Hybrid Exchange, mail flow, connectors, transport rules.
* Manage M365 Admin Center, retention policies, and compliance.
* Implement SPF, DKIM, DMARC and email security solutions (ProofPoint, Mimecast).
* Perform migration and upgrades for Exchange and M365 services.


- Collaboration \& Productivity Tools

* Manage SharePoint Online, OneDrive, and Teams (including migrations).
* Configure permissions, workflows, and Power Automate integrations.
* Ensure security and compliance across collaboration platforms.
* Endpoint Management
+ Administer Intune for device enrollment, compliance, and app protection.
+ Configure Autopilot for device provisioning and hybrid join.
+ Implement Conditional Access and certificate management.

* Virtualization \& Desktop Solutions
+ Manage Cloud PC (Windows 365\) provisioning and integration with Intune.
+ Configure and support Azure Virtual Desktop (AVD).
+ Knowledge on Citrix Desktop Virtualization.

* Windows Server \& Infrastructure
+ Manage Active Directory, DNS, DHCP, Group Policies, and clustering.
+ Implement DFS (Distributed File System) for file replication and namespace management.
+ Configure Hyper\-V, IIS, NPS, and certificate management.
+ Automate tasks using PowerShell scripting.
+ Ensure high availability and performance monitoring.

* Security \& Compliance
+ Implement Data Loss Prevention, threat management, and audit logging.
+ Ensure adherence to regulatory compliance across all platforms.

* Migration Expertise
+ Lead on\-prem to cloud migrations, tenant\-to\-tenant migrations, and upgrades across all Microsoft workloads and virtualization platforms.

* Possess basic Linux administration and troubleshooting skills.


****Required Skills \& Experience****
* 8 \- 12 years in IT infrastructure.
* Hands\-on experience in:
+ Azure services (VMs, networking, storage, RBAC, security).
+ Exchange Online \& On\-Prem, M365, Intune, AutoPilot.
+ SharePoint, Teams, OneDrive administration and migration.
+ DFS implementation and management.
+ VMware \& Citrix environments.

* Strong PowerShell scripting and automation skills.
* Expertise in security and compliance for Microsoft 365 and Azure.
* Proven track record in large\-scale migration projects.
* Understanding and execution of ITIL framework (Especially; Problem, Change Management, RCA and RFC process and procedures)
* Should be well versed in communication (English, Written and Oral) and be able to co\-ordinate efficiently with onsite sub\-ordinates and direct in\-line managers
* Provide excellent customer service to internal IT customers and application owners and users.
* Remain vigilant while continuing to maintain and enhance the overall security of Alphaserve and the client’s receiving our services.
* Maintain awareness about the potential risks based on the environment they are operating in and the clients they are working on


**Working Conditions**
* Ability to work in an independent environment with moderate supervision
* Ability to work under a moderate noise level (i.e. working on an open floor with printers, telephones, and computers)
* Ability to travel for business and work beyond normal business hours when necessary
* Ability to be flexible and successfully respond to multiple work pressures
* Sitting for extended periods of time
* Dexterity of hands and fingers to operate a computer keyboard, mouse, power tools, and to handle other computer components
* Lifting and transporting of moderately heavy objects, such as computers and peripherals


****About ECI****
 ECI is a leading provider in the financial industry of cloud and technical solutions. With over 25 years in business, ECI has upheld a reputation of developing top\-tier industry technologists by allowing them to work in fast\-paced and dynamic environments. Focusing on a “promote from within” culture allows our team to grow both personally and professionally.
   

  

 ECI’s culture is all about connection \- connection with our clients, our technology and most importantly with each other. In addition to working with an amazing team around the world, ECI also offers a competitive compensation package and so much more! If you believe you would be a great fit and are ready for your best job ever,
 **we would like to hear from you!**
